implementation: New original Java runtime; not a reconstruction of the excluded reference code or historical binary.
historical_resource_policy: Keep resources/ byte-identical; modify only packaged mcmod.info display metadata and append the new recovery item language key during processResources.
entity_id_evidence: Recovered entity language key only; historical binary registry and numeric entity ID are unverified.
dimension_evidence: Recovered mcmod.info specifies five 5x5 wall pictures.

schema.ValeStandardVariant: stone|sand|mist|leaf|cloud; empty string is explicitly unassigned
schema.ValeStandardOrigin: stable UUID for bounded per-origin recovery archival
schema.ValeStandardOwner: UUID of the most recent placing player, informational only
schema.ValeStandardItem: one item with its original metadata and without nested ValeStandardHistory

unknown_data_policy: Retain unknown NBT without guessing its village; display a visible breakable unassigned panel, preserve history in a recovery item and a first-seen per-origin WorldSavedData archive on break, then permit explicit operator resolution.
archive_growth: One first-seen record per stable original UUID; repeated item/entity cycles do not append or overwrite records.
migration_limit: No actual old-world or old-binary entity/NBT contract is available; automatic legacy placement compatibility is not claimed.
visual_acceptance: Requires a real Minecraft client check; component and dedicated-server checks alone do not verify rendered appearance.
